propositions: compact.py exceeds 800 LOC (798) and bundles three unrelated responsibilities: transaction logic, snapshot reconstruction, and CLI surface with high local complexity (CCN 24-21)
Circular import risk: shared snapshot primitives and _git must live in compact_txn to avoid rebuild importing txn and txn importing rebuild

Public API consumers outside the module (fsck_repair, fsck_restore, tests) import rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log and snapshot helpers through compact module, requiring re-exports to preserve paths without editing call sites

Monkeypatch test seams in test_compact_negative.py patch _git and lock on compact module object, but after split _compact_locked reads compact_txn globals, so patches must be repointed to new module homes

Counter co-location: _REBUILD_COUNT and get_rebuild_count must move together to compact_rebuild because rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log does global _REBUILD_COUNT; leaving get_rebuild_count in compact.py reads different module global and silently reports zero
